entries.title: Manage Part Categories
entries.description: Create, rename and select standard Part Categories from the Admin area and Part forms. Bulk imports and filters now use these managed categories.

entries.title: Set category markup
entries.description: Set a markup percentage for each Part Category to support consistent pricing.

entries.title: Merge duplicate Part Categories
entries.description: Combine duplicate categories and move their Parts into one selected category.

entries.title: Add inventory Parts to quote work items
entries.description: Select an existing inventory Part when adding a custom work item to a Quote.

entries.title: Create Parts Sale Quotes
entries.description: Use the new Parts Sale Quote type for sales that should not create a Job.

entries.title: Manage stock for Parts Sales
entries.description: Check out and return stock against a Parts Sale from the app or Stores Tablet. The Quote shows stock still out and warns you before cancellation.

entries.title: Add inventory Parts to quote work items
entries.description: Select an existing inventory Part when adding a custom work item to a Quote.
